fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on gallons expected to be consumed in 2009, for every one-cent increase in the cost of jet fuel, our annual fuel expense increases by approximately $1.4 million.

instrument_type_details.notes: Fuel hedge program includes heating oil futures, swaps, crude oil caps (call options), and synthetic collars. Not designated as SFAS 133 hedges. FV liability $10.0M at Dec 31 2008, with $17.5M cash collateral posted. As of Feb 13, 2009 required $13.0M collateral. Ceiling volumes: Q1 2009 17,304k gal (53%), Q2 13,272k gal (40%), Q3 7,686k gal (23%), Q4 2,478k gal (8%), Q1 2010 252k gal (1%). Floor volumes for collars also shown. Total ceiling 2009 ~40.74M gallons.

warnings: Volume table as of Feb 13, 2009; ceiling and floor volumes shown separately for collar positions; FV -$10.0M is combined for all contracts at Dec 31 2008; 2009 volume uses ceiling (call) side of collars; not designated as SFAS 133 cash flow hedges
